instruction: Cinematic full shot of an indoor boxing gym with a misty atmosphere and a red mural on the wall. On the left, the shirtless man in black boxing shorts (R1) stands in profile, wearing black boxing gloves in a defensive stance, looking at his opponent. On the right, the bearded shirtless man (R3) faces him, wearing green boxing gloves and colorful leggings in a boxing stance, focused on R1. The two men are positioned opposite each other, ready to spar. Cool overhead lights create dramatic backlighting through the mist, contrasting with the warm red background.
